mode: Read-only screenshot inspection, pixel validation and matching current stylesheet; no fixture actions
scope: Only the visible top authorized attachment dialog at 1440x1000; manually addresses the two axe incomplete rules

evidence.path_basis: Paths are relative to the release root, so this review can be re-checked on any machine rather than only where it was written.
evidence.screenshot_note: Re-captured in the 1.8 round. PNG encoding bytes differ between runs, so the hash above is the shipped file, not a rendering fingerprint. The six pixel counts below were re-counted on this exact capture inside the recorded sample boxes and reproduced the original numbers exactly, so the rendering of this dialog is unchanged.
evidence.stylesheet_note: The stylesheet hash moved when the search-result mark styles and the CJK font fallbacks were added. Neither touches this dialog: the sampled foreground and background colours and all six pixel counts are unchanged, which is why this review still stands.

font_note: 14px CSS normal text; declared system font stack is Segoe UI/Microsoft YaHei/Noto Sans SC. Resolved fallback font was not queried. The normal-text contrast threshold was used.

always_visible_cues: Standalone action row labelled 查看受限原网页
Visible outward arrow icon beside link text
link_non_color_identification.assessment: The standalone action wording, layout and arrow identify navigation without relying only on its blue color; it is separate from surrounding paragraph text.

visual_observations: Top dialog has an opaque white surface; paragraph, input text and link are clear and unobscured in the screenshot.
The empty textarea interior sampled as solid white. The lower dialog is intentionally dimmed and excluded from this visible-layer contrast check.
limits: The axe incomplete entries remain automated scan results; this is a separate targeted manual assessment.
